candidate_relations.reason: The findings support hereditary hypophosphatemic rickets with hypercalciuria, characterized by FGF23-independent phosphate wasting, elevated 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D, and nephrocalcinosis. X-linked hypophosphatemia is FGF23-mediated and generally has elevated or inappropriately normal FGF23 rather than undetectable FGF23.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Incorrect hereditary hypophosphatemic rickets subtype and mechanism.
